about: A live run of V9-acceptance-checks, recorded for replay.

features.name: Kilometres to miles
features.request: A unit converter from kilometres to miles

hooks.name: km-input
hooks.says: The field where the person types a number of kilometres.

hooks.name: miles-input
hooks.says: The field where the person types a number of miles.

hooks.name: to-miles-button
hooks.says: The control that converts the kilometres typed in the km field into miles.

hooks.name: to-km-button
hooks.says: The control that converts the miles typed in the miles field into kilometres.

hooks.name: miles-result
hooks.says: The element that shows the miles result of a conversion.

hooks.name: km-result
hooks.says: The element that shows the kilometres result of a conversion.

checks.says: Typing 100 kilometres and converting to miles shows about 62.1 miles.
Typing 10 miles and converting to kilometres shows about 16.09 kilometres.

value.name: Kilometres and miles
value.summary: Convert kilometres to miles and miles to kilometres. Type a number in either field and press its button.

code.html:
Kilometres ⇄ miles

Result in miles will show here.

Result in kilometres will show here.

features.name: Word count
features.request: tells me the number of words

features.name: Character count
features.request: tells me the number of ... characters

hooks.name: text-input
hooks.says: The text box where the person pastes or types their text.

hooks.name: word-count
hooks.says: The element that shows the number of words in the text.

hooks.name: character-count
hooks.says: The element that shows the number of characters in the text.

checks.says: Pasting four words shows four words.
Pasting four words shows twenty-two characters.
Pasting two different words shows two words.

value.interfacePart: Now a tip calculator: the bill, the tip percent and the number of people, showing what each person pays.

hooks.name: bill-input
hooks.says: The field where the person types the bill total.

hooks.name: tip-percent-input
hooks.says: The field where the person types the tip percentage.

hooks.name: people-count-input
hooks.says: The field where the person types the number of people splitting the bill.

hooks.name: amount-per-person
hooks.says: The element that shows what each person pays.

checks.says: Splitting a 100 bill with a 20 percent tip between 4 people shows 30.00 each.
Splitting a 60 bill with a 15 percent tip between 3 people shows 23.00 each.
Changing the number of people to 2 on a 100 bill with a 10 percent tip shows 55.00 each.
